command:
cd /tmp/ch1-ref/os && ELF=target/riscv64gc-unknown-none-elf/debug/os && mkdir -p /tmp/ch1-ref/reports && gdb -nx -q -batch "$ELF" \
 -ex 'set architecture riscv:rv64' \
 -ex 'tbreak rust_main' \
 -ex 'tbreak os::clear_bss' \
 -ex 'tbreak os::logging::init' \
 -ex 'tbreak os::console::print' \
 -ex 'tbreak os::sbi::console_putchar' \
 -ex 'info breakpoints' 2>&1
